record.kind: Own Cherokee primary-source evidence for five import diagnostics

fresh_web_context.finding: Official Cherokee Nation page identifies OU Englutan as an English-sorted wordlist. Official Microsoft guide index links Cherokee. Following the official guide link returned unsupported application/octet-stream, not an access denial. Linguistic evidence is the retained hash-verified TBX and PDFs actually read/visually inspected, not a claimed fresh PDF download.

OU_entries.sense_control: Exact again adverb, not the second or more variants.
Exact command form. Corroborates the GUI choose TBX entry; no conjugation invented.
Complete chosen form, not person-specific agasuyeda or plural-person gegasuyeda. No POS tag is invented for this source row. Pre-nominal chosen-source application is authored.
Standalone no response to the permission topic; does not synthesize a negative finite predicate.
None scopes only to the named picker/transfer outcome, not to source-file existence or contents on disk.
Opening activity, not a physical gap (the neighboring there-is-an-opening forms). File-picker launch is a disclosed interface extension.
Result topic scopes no-file/contents to this attempt. No finite returned verb or general inexistence claim.
General permission noun, avoiding narrower administrative shared-resource TBX permissions or unsupported block-contact sense.
Deictic this with the image topic, not original-file identity.

style_evidence.finding: Adjectives normally precede the noun; articles are not used. Supports the chosen-source qualifier and this-image topic, but does not certify entire authored diagnostics.

Nouns can serve singular or plural reference, with number often carried by the verb. A bare file category under none does not require invented plural affixes. Both no-file and no-files use the same zero-result topic; only the source-requested single-file retry differs.

Cherokee verbs carry ordered pronominal prefix, stem and tense suffix. This packet preserves whole entries and exact imperative choose; it invents no finite blocked/returned/received/decoded conjugation.

sense_decisions.decision: Use complete technical file picker term exactly; it denotes a UI element for locating/selecting files, not a person.

Use digital-media content sense with explicit image and file topics. It denotes the actual media payload, not general information about the image. Do not cite same-spelled File Explorer Content view20683 as this sense.
Use source as a functional provider paraphrase: a data collection from which content is taken. Chosen qualifier retains selected. Do not assert a company.
Reject literal provider noun for this packet because its full definition is a company serving customers, not an Android content-provider component.
Reject block verb because its full definition is preventing a user conversation/presence access. Use opening-permission:no instead.
Retain technical bitmap exactly as the Cherokee TBX does. Content-to-bitmap failed transformation identifies decode without inventing a linguistic translate/decode verb.

composition_contract: All complete proposed diagnostics are authored compact topic/result compositions, not quotations or native-speaker-certified sentences. Whole source words remain unchanged.

Em dashes delimit named topics. Colons introduce a result/state. The right arrow in provider and decode rows is authored direction/transformation notation; it is not asserted to be Cherokee morphology or attested source syntax.
Picker outcome:file:none is distinct from a file whose data is empty or a statement that no files exist. The result topic anchors the absence.
Selected source → AN Paint outcome:image-file content:none scopes none to content received on this route, leaving metadata and source existence unknown.
Android:(this image/file/content → bitmap):failure states the failed decoding transformation and its actor. No RAM insufficiency, full-file corruption or later colour-conversion failure is asserted.
rejected_paths: No machine translation or cross-language extrapolation. CH packets locate caller semantics only.
Do not turn flexible/liquid/human-specific OU receive forms into guessed digital-payload finite sentences.
Do not use a generic failure string alone for any of these five stage-specific diagnostics.
record.confidence: Moderate compositional confidence. Exact lexical anchors and code contracts are strong; fluent naturalness, arrow comprehension/accessibility, Android glyph/layout and runtime display remain unverified. No whole-GUI attestation or native check is used as a mandatory gate.

record.kind: Own-source evidence for four NHE text-control candidates and two font-family gaps
record.identity: Tlahtolxitlauhcayotl. Chicontepec, Veracruz, John Sullivan and Chicontepec coauthors, Warsaw 2016, ISBN 978-83-63636-51-7. Modern own-variety definitions are used; bracketed classical-only senses are not used.

entries.sense_and_productive_use: Sense 1 is arranging letters, words and longer verbal units to express something with ink or a computer. Sense 2 is readable written work on paper or a computer. Used as written text in all four rows; this is explicit textual content, not generic surface drawing. Digital text is directly within this definition, while each complete GUI phrase is authored.

Perform a task and make something. Combined productively with the explicitly readable-written-content noun. Creating written text is a functional input invitation rather than a literal keyboard-typing claim.
Exact singular do/make-it command. The full written-text composition is authored, not quoted.

Place a thing where it is intended to be. Extending the object to written text positioned on an image is authored and matches the application insertion operation, not clipboard pasting or creation of a font.
Exact singular place-it command. The object in the source example is furniture, not digital text; the digital written-text object is the explicit authored extension.

Sense 2 reproduces something elsewhere; sense 1 removing corn is excluded. Own past stem copīnqui supplies the completed-copy status, with ni- and c-. Clipboard transfer is the same bounded technical extension used for ui_copy_all, not a claim that this dictionary gives a clipboard noun.
Complete inanimate content, not person-specific plural. In this caller it denotes the entire supplied legal-text body and not all documents or files.
First-person subject prefix. App-voice first person is consistent with existing NHE saved/error statuses. Niccopinqui is ni-c-copinqui, retaining both adjacent c letters.
Specific third-person object prefix. The text is the inanimate object of copying.

The source explains unmarked everyday vowel length in definitions/examples versus marked pedagogical headwords. The four values use the existing NHE unmarked convention; source headwords retain macrons in evidence.

A writing/reading letter. Supports letters as a concept but does not by itself distinguish typographic family selection from other changes to written appearance. This entry supports the precise font gaps only.

font_search.bounded_scope: Pinned own Chicontepec dictionary text, existing NHE packets, and actual FontCatalog/TextStyleDialog behavior. Not an assertion that the language lacks a term.
searched: typographic/font equivalents and source entries for letters, writing, appearance and shapes
font_search.findings: No typographic-family-specific own source was found in this bounded pass. The one Latin substring font occurs inside BOFONTŌNTIC, an unrelated tree-shape word. General TLACHIYALIZTLI at PDF484/printed469 describes appearance, including paint colour in its example. It was read as text, not raster-verified, and is not used to authorize candidate wording.

record.limits: These are functional own-source compositions, not exact attested GUI phrases, native-speaker approval, runtime/glyph/layout certification or permission to integrate. Two font/family rows remain gaps because generic writing/appearance would not identify the font selector precisely enough.

row_findings.linguistic_reason: The primary inatyik entry explicitly includes the noun sense option, not only its separate verbal reading. Chung printed page111 permits postnominal plural siha. The resulting nominal heading is a functional paraphrase of Settings.
row_findings.caller_reason: AppLanguage.showSettings displays the current language as a selectable row leading to showPicker. Options is true of this actual setting container and makes no mutation or completion claim.
row_findings.confidence: Moderate source-backed authored functional composition; not native-speaker or whole-phrase certification

row_findings.linguistic_reason: The primary na'hålum entry explicitly has the transitive insert sense, with picture and letter insertion examples. The primary tapblung entry supplies tinige'-ña as writing in an object expression. Removing the possessive suffix yields the writing/text noun used here; this is an authored composition, not a separately attested headword or software phrase. Chung printed pages117 and339 support the null indefinite article and bare transitive imperative. The source spelling hålum is intentional and not silently replaced by older app halom.
row_findings.caller_reason: The sole direct consumer is the title of TextStyleDialog. It gathers entered text and style, then its positive-button callback invokes document.text(x,y,...) through ClassicPaintActivity. Insert writing names that operation without claiming that placement already succeeded or that all text comes from a particular input mechanism.
row_findings.confidence: Moderate source-backed authored functional composition; not native-speaker or whole-phrase certification

row_findings.linguistic_reason: Primary patcha is a transitive touching verb and pinenta is a picture noun. The transitive imperative with an un-marked singular indefinite object is supported by Chung printed pages117 and339. Primary fine'na explicitly expresses temporal first and occurs after an imperative in an attested example. The proposed sentence therefore expresses a prerequisite, not the first image by ordinal position.
row_findings.caller_reason: Both actual direct consumers are the Unplace and Remove branches when selected is null. Tray click sets selected and calls board.select; board onSelect also writes selected, and its touch-up branch selects the touched top image. The instruction supplies the prerequisite without claiming that touching deletes, unplaces, or saves anything.
row_findings.confidence: Moderate source-backed authored functional composition; not native-speaker or whole-phrase certification

row_findings.linguistic_reason: Primary tugi' is the write verb, and its numerical example directly attests numiru with the disdi...asta range construction. The indefinite un restricts the request to one number, rather than a request to write the entire range. The ordered unit-step enumeration explicitly identifies the nonnegative integer class and avoids inventing an unattested whole-number term. It is an authored explanatory addition, not a source quotation.
row_findings.caller_reason: The only resource consumer is NumericSlider's exact-entry dialog. Its callback parses with toIntOrNull and admits n only within minimum..maximum, an inclusive range. All production control minima are 0, 1, 40 or 100. The parenthetic class is immediately followed by both dynamic endpoints in their original order, each exactly once; it does not erase a boundary or say that every listed member is valid for every slider. The wording excludes fractions and is appropriate for all present nonnegative ranges.
row_findings.confidence: Moderate source-backed authored functional composition; not native-speaker or whole-phrase certification

finding.bounded_meaning: Android does not permit this file-picker opening; exception detail follows.
finding.lexical_and_grammar: The exact file-picker technical noun denotes a UI element. OU opening is the opening activity form, distinct from there-is-an-opening forms. General permission plus standalone no supplies a topic/state paraphrase without inventing a finite blocked form. The punctuation does not require an unattested negated conjugation.
finding.caller_fit: PASS. Three SecurityException launch emitters. ClassicPaintActivity and AssemblyActivity use the nullable message; LegacyImageCreditsActivity uses the message or a localized fallback. That third caller launches ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT for text credits, so generic file picker is necessary. No missing-app, missing-file-result or image-only assertion. The nested ACTION_GET_CONTENT ActivityNotFoundException fallback is not asserted to be covered by its sibling SecurityException catch.
finding.scope_control: No particular manifest permission, permanent restriction or recovery instruction is added. Opening-permission:no is a functional description of the blocked launch, not a claim that the user can fix it by granting a named permission.

row_findings.confidence: Moderate source-compositional. Exact lexical and caller support; no native-fluency, accessibility or runtime certification.

finding.bounded_meaning: The file-picker result contains no file reference; choose the file again.
finding.lexical_and_grammar: Outcome/effect scopes none to the picker result. Exact TBX file plus OU none expresses a zero-item category. The exact GUI choose form is independently corroborated as choose it (imperative) on OU page99. OU again is used unchanged before that complete imperative.
finding.caller_fit: PASS. ClassicPaintActivity1178 rejects non-RESULT_OK before the URI extraction at1250. At1251, neither data.data nor the first clipData URI is available. The diagnostic precedes open/import/save/export dispatch and is not image-specific.
finding.scope_control: The repeat-selection action is retained once. It does not demand a different file and does not impose a one-retry maximum. No claim that a physical file is missing or its content empty.

row_findings.confidence: Moderate source-compositional. Exact lexical and caller support; no native-fluency, accessibility or runtime certification.

finding.bounded_meaning: The multiple-file picker result contains no file references.
finding.lexical_and_grammar: The shared outcome:file:none construction is a scoped zero-result expression. Cherokee noun number need not be mechanically pluralized; styleguide page18 supports unmarked nouns and number often expressed in verbs. No guessed plural prefix or finite return predicate is added.
finding.caller_fit: PASS. AssemblyActivity199-201 requires ADD_IMAGES and RESULT_OK and tests an empty URI list. Multiple selection is requested at188. This branch precedes reading or decoding.
finding.scope_control: No retry instruction is added to this source string. It is distinct from the single-file-result string by the latter's explicit retry action, without manufacturing a contradictory count.

row_findings.confidence: Moderate source-compositional. Exact lexical and caller support; no native-fluency, accessibility or runtime certification.

finding.bounded_meaning: For the attempted chosen-source→AN Paint transfer, the image-file-content result is none.
finding.lexical_and_grammar: OU chosen is a complete source form, not the neighboring person-specific forms. The prenominal modifier is consistent with styleguide page15, while its use with source is disclosed composition. TBX source denotes a data-origin object. TBX content entry9084 is digital-media payload, not the same-spelled File Explorer Content view or general metadata.
finding.caller_fit: PASS. ClassicPaintActivity1273-1274 has an existing URI but contentResolver.openInputStream(uri) returns null, so the copy body is not entered. An attempted receiving route is exactly the narrow relation that source→AN Paint plus outcome states.
finding.scope_control: The arrow has source on the left and receiving app on the right. Outcome and the parenthesized image/file/content topic scope none to content received on that attempted route. This does not say every source object, file or datum is absent, destroyed, corrupt or zero-length. Source functionally represents the selected provider without falsely specifying an external company.

row_findings.confidence: Moderate source-compositional. Exact lexical and caller support; no native-fluency, accessibility or runtime certification.

finding.bounded_meaning: Android failed at the transformation of this image-file content to a bitmap.
finding.lexical_and_grammar: OU this and exact TBX image/file/digital-content/bitmap/failure anchors are retained. Parentheses make the input→bitmap relation the subject of failure; Android is the actor/topic. This is authored technical notation, not an invented finite decode form or a claimed source sentence.
finding.caller_fit: PASS. ImageImport161-162 throws this message only when BitmapFactory.decodeFile returns null. withPlatformFile can prepare a BMP from DIB, and PlatformImageColour.withDecodeFile can prepare colour-input data. The relation remains content→bitmap without promising the bytes are the original untouched input.
finding.scope_control: No bitmap result from this transformation is implied. The wording does not assert general Android inability, later colour.convert failure, orientation/resize failure, absent picker/provider payload, diagnosed corruption, or OOM. The memory guard at149 is a separate branch.

row_findings.reason: The actual caller is the multiline composition-field hint, not a canvas action or the font selector. Xicchihua is attested in the own-source IUHQUINON example; the make/do construction takes the explicit written-text noun. The functional invitation accurately asks for composition without falsely requiring a physical keyboard or claiming insertion has happened.

Xictlali is an exact own-source command; TLALIA supplies the intended placement sense. The positive button validates size and spacing and then commits the rendered text through ClassicPaintActivity into PaintDocument. This labels the intended action rather than claiming success for blank/invalid input.

This is the dialog title opened for a selected canvas position. The imperative names its operation without asserting completion. Reusing Add text wording is semantically justified because the dialog and its positive button concern the same placement operation.

row_findings.meaning: I copied all of the written text.
row_findings.reason: The own-source COPINA copying/reproduction sense and listed past stem copinqui support ni-c-copinqui. NI1 and C2 support the first-person subject and specific third-person object; both adjacent c letters are retained. Nochi scopes the written-text object. LegalInfo copies the complete supplied body to the system clipboard before emitting the status; the wording does not promise saving, sharing, a later paste, or copying UI headings.
